Chapter 6162: Dao Derivation

Chapter 6162: Dao Derivation

“It’s time to show your skill so that you can die with dignity.” Li Qiye waved provocatively.

“This is too overbearing, right?” Someone remarked, unfamiliar with the absurd situation.

Some were old enough to meet mighty emperors and primal ancestors. None was as arrogant as Li Qiye. They viewed others as ants, but not apex emperors like Li Qiye.

“My dynasty will not fall to you.” Allmountain said with a grave tone.

“You think too highly of yourself and your dynasty. No place is safe from me.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“What about Supreme Heaven?!” A crowd member couldn’t help but shout.

“Just as simple to destroy.” Li Qiye said nonchalantly.

“!!!” Everyone gasped and shuddered.

“Even an immortal can’t be this arrogant.” Someone else said.

“Hahaha…” Golden Flower couldn’t help but laugh: “I want to see just how powerful you are today.”

“I am the first to never give up regardless of how terrifying the foes may be.” Transcendent remained in high spirits.

He pointed at Li Qiye and said: “You might be the strongest but I will not yield before witnessing your true ability.”

Everyone understood a single apex emperor stood no chance against Li Qiye. This applied to those on the limit path as well. The six of them needed to work together just to stay alive, let alone kill him. However, Transcendent wanted to challenge Li Qiye alone first.

“Transcendent is the most brilliant in this era, it’s understandable that he’s not convinced.” A desolate god said.

He had ample pride and confidence as a genius who was praised by Poye. He knew of Li Qiye’s might but still wanted to try.

“My true ability is unnecessary to kill you, just one punch is enough.” LI Qiye said.

“I see.” Transcendent didn’t lose his composure and said: “It seems that I am overestimating myself. Shall we get started?”

“Buzz.” Two golden wings manifested into reality. Their golden light burst forth and temporarily blinded everyone.

“Dao Derivation!” He roared.

Once the crowd’s eyes adjusted and their sight returned, they saw an exquisite golden radiance. It was not as dazzling and overwhelming as before.

As it cascaded downward, it seemed to represent the true noble path capable of uplifting worlds and sheltering all living beings. They felt that the world was welcoming an unrivaled paradise with extreme bliss and salvation.

After a complete activation, three thousand Transcendent Emperors appeared along with three thousand worlds. They were tangible and indistinguishable from one another.

“Which one is real?” Someone asked.

“They’re all real?” An emperor said with his legs trembling.

“His dao birthed three thousand worlds and three thousand selves. Dao Derivation.” A desolate god said with admiration.

“A bit interesting, but far from enough.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Very well, here is my ultimate move!” The countless Transcendents roared, making everyone else feel like specks of dust.

“Boom!” The worlds came together in an apocalyptic fashion.

“Damn!” The destructive impact terrified everyone.

“Three Thousand Worlds Slash!” When his dao reached its peak and the worlds collided and merged, he became one again. The powers and fortunes of the avatars became his as he swung his blade.

No one could see brilliant slash clearly, not even emperors using their heavenly gaze.

“Boom!” Sin seemed to be cut into two halves.

“This strike has to be at the limit of the dao, it can break the limit path!” An emperor turned pale and said.
